Bitcoin New ($BTCN) is a community token deployed on the BNB Smart Chain in October 2026. Its design references Bitcoin’s fixed maximum supply: $BTCN has a fixed total supply of 21,000,000 tokens, and the contract contains no minting function, so the supply cannot be increased after deployment.

The token applies an 8% tax on buy and sell transactions executed through its liquidity pool. The tax rate is capped at 8% in the contract code as a hard-coded maximum fee and cannot be set higher. Collected tax is swapped to BNB and sent to a designated marketing wallet used to fund promotion and operations. Standard wallet-to-wallet transfers are not taxed.

A central element of the project is its deflationary supply policy. The stated objective is to reduce the circulating supply over time, with a target of burning at least 90% of the total supply. A portion of the supply is held in a separate Burn Vault contract, which is restricted so that tokens placed in it can only be sent to the dead address (0x…dEaD); the contract has no function to sell or withdraw those tokens. Burns from the vault are performed manually, at a planned pace of approximately 1% per day. Tokens sent to the dead address are permanently removed from circulation.

Liquidity for $BTCN was provided on PancakeSwap version 2 against WBNB. The liquidity provider (LP) tokens were sent to the dead address, which makes the initial liquidity position non-retrievable.

At launch, the contract enforces a per-transaction and per-wallet limit of 0.1% of the total supply (21,000 tokens) as an anti-concentration measure. This limit can be removed by the contract owner through a one-way function. Public trading is controlled by a one-way function: once trading is opened, it cannot be closed again.

The contract is written in Solidity, built on widely used open-source token libraries, and is verified on BscScan. It does not include a blacklist function or a pause function. Ownership of the contract is intended to be renounced after the launch phase, after which parameters such as the tax rate can no longer be changed.

The project plans to introduce a staking feature that would allow holders to lock $BTCN in exchange for rewards. The staking rewards pool is intended to be funded once the token reaches a market capitalization of 1,000,000 USD.

$BTCN is a meme-oriented token and does not represent a technology platform, security, or claim on assets. Its contract address on BNB Smart Chain is 0x5f0D55D366E0D1F37Ab7e150b989048b24DFc2ad.

The meme comes from Block’s Dessa announcement: an AI model trained on human speech rather than text. Our parody turns that into a familiar crypto personality—the person who never reads the whitepaper but has the most to say in Spaces.

“Never read the whitepaper. Still took over the Spaces.” captures the joke immediately. The oversized human mouth on a desktop speaker makes the character recognisable, while the disconnected mute button reinforces its personality: professionally unmuted.

The name, mascot, spoken Yap Archive and personalised yap receipts support one coherent idea. Community members can claim the identity through their own unsolicited opinions, endless voice notes and “so basically…” replies. Every long explanation becomes another opportunity to reuse the meme.

Its strongest contrast is zero reading versus unlimited confidence. That gives it relevance beyond the launch headline and plenty of remix potential.
